title: Cohere · 模型列表来源更新
summary: 模型列表新增 embed-v5.0-fast 和 embed-v5.0-pro 两个嵌入模型，分别标注为轻量快速版和最高质量版，支持文本、图像及混合输入，且两者共享嵌入空间。

added_lines: | embed-v5.0-fast | A faster, lighter version of embed-v5.0-pro. Allows for text and images to be classified or turned into embeddings | Text, Images, Mixed texts/images (i.e. PDFs) | One of ‘[256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048 (default)]‘ | 128k | Cosine Similarity, Dot Product Similarity, Euclidean Distance | Embed
| embed-v5.0-fast | N/A | Unique per deployment | Cohere-Embed-V5-Fast
| embed-v5.0-pro | N/A | Unique per deployment | Cohere-Embed-V5-Pro

| embed-v5.0-pro | Our most capable embedding model, for text and images. Higher quality than embed-v5.0-fast, at higher latency. | Text, Images, Mixed texts/images (i.e. PDFs) | One of ‘[256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048 (default)]‘ | 128k | Cosine Similarity, Dot Product Similarity, Euclidean Distance | Embed
